entries.en: A nice looking bottle. You notice someone scratched "Rob" on the bottom of it.
entries.zh: 一只漂亮的瓶子。你注意到有人在瓶底刻了“罗布”两个字。

entries.en: The Healing Power of Flora and Fungi
entries.zh: 草木菌菇的疗愈之力

entries.en: An extensive list of recipes to help cure all manner of common ailments. Ointments, poultices, drinks and soups, the remedies are accompanied by colourful illustrations and even guides as to where one may locate the relevant plants, herbs and mushrooms contained within them.
entries.zh: 书中收录了大量治疗常见病症的配方，包括药膏、敷剂、饮品和汤剂。每种疗法都配有彩色插图，甚至介绍了去哪里寻找所需的植物、药草和蘑菇。

entries.en: A guide to blood and its many uses in the field of medicine. How blood functions in the body and why it is so vital to health. There are also sections of the book that deal with the history of blood work in the medical field, and the mythology and folklore surrounding blood in a more general sense. Apparently there was once a cult that mimicked a certain annoying insect and sustained themselves on a diet of nothing but the blood of other humans, believing mistakenly it would give them eternal life.
entries.zh: 一本介绍血液及其各种医疗用途的指南，讲解血液在体内如何运作，以及它为何对健康至关重要。书中也有章节讲述血液疗法的发展史，以及更广泛的血液神话与民间传说。据说曾有一个教派模仿某种讨厌的昆虫，只靠吸食人血为生，误以为这样便能长生不老。

entries.en: The Book of Stones
entries.zh: 石之书

entries.en: Not, as one may guess, a guide to the treatment of liver and bladder stones. Rather an elaborate and extensive list of minerals, their properties, and how one may use them in medicinal practices. The largest section of the book deals with the processes that must be followed in order to properly extract a specific mineral from certain types of rock.
entries.zh: 这并非你可能想到的肝胆或膀胱结石治疗指南，而是一份详尽的矿物名录，介绍其特性及医疗用途。书中篇幅最大的一部分讲解如何遵循正确步骤，从特定岩石中提取某种矿物。

entries.en: The Practitioner's Guide
entries.zh: 医师指南

entries.en:
Book I - Diagnosis

Explains the necessary steps required to properly diagnose a patient's condition or disease. Notable chapters include: Physical testing and examination. Determining a patient's medical history by means of written record. Determining a patient's medical history by interview or questionnaire. Diagnostic procedures. How best to avoid misdiagnosis. How best to give the bad news. How best to avoid contracting illness yourself. Lastly a chapter called: What is that? No I'm not touching it, get away from me! Deals with the most grotesque and repulsive boils, warts, rashes and sexually transmitted diseases.
entries.zh:
第一卷——诊断

本卷讲解正确诊断病情所需的步骤。主要章节包括：身体测试与检查；根据文字记录了解病史；通过问诊或问卷了解病史；诊断流程；如何尽量避免误诊；如何告知坏消息；如何避免自己染病。最后一章名为“那是什么？不，我不碰它，离我远点！”，讨论各种最为骇人恶心的脓疮、疣、皮疹及性病。

entries.en: The Power of Blood
entries.zh: 血液的力量

entries.en: The Practitioner's Guide
entries.zh: 医师指南

entries.en:
Book II - Anatomy

A detailed guide to the human anatomy. Every limb, organ, vessel, tissue, bone and muscle broken down and elaborated on to great extent. Full of near perfectly accurate illustrations, strange sounding names and terms, and lists of functions.
entries.zh:
第二卷——解剖

一部详尽的人体解剖指南，对每一处肢体、器官、血管、组织、骨骼和肌肉都作了深入阐述。书中满是近乎完全准确的插图、古怪的名称与术语，以及功能列表。

entries.en: The Practitioner's Guide
entries.zh: 医师指南

entries.en:
Book III - Treatment 

A glossary of every known condition or disease. The book does not offer specifics in how to prepare and administer treatments. Rather it lists the name of the illness then references other books where the specifics may be found, mainly within The Books of Healing written by the same author.
entries.zh:
第三卷——治疗 

本卷罗列所有已知病症，却不具体讲解疗法的准备与实施，而是在每个病名后注明可供查阅的其他书籍，主要是同一作者撰写的《疗愈之书》。

entries.en: The Books of Healing
entries.zh: 疗愈之书

entries.en: The Books of Healing
entries.zh: 疗愈之书

entries.en: The Books of Healing
entries.zh: 疗愈之书

entries.en: The Books of Healing
entries.zh: 疗愈之书

entries.en:
Book I - Herbs and Plants 

An extensive examination of the healing properties of herbs and plants. The book is organised into two sections. The first lists individual plants and herbs, what properties they have and the 
illnesses they treat, even going as far as how best to cultivate them. The second is dedicated to the preparation of medicines, often involving highly complex and laborious methods.
entries.zh:
第一卷——药草与植物 

本卷详尽研究药草与植物的疗效，共分两部分。第一部分逐一介绍各种植物和药草的特性、能够治疗的
疾病，甚至讲解最佳栽培方式。第二部分专讲制药，所述方法往往极为复杂且费时费力。

entries.en:
Book II - Animals 

Primarily details the usage of animals in the preparation of various medicines. Everything from breast milk, to gall, to ground bone marrow and even brain tissue, are suggested as vital ingredients in treatments for a range of diseases and lesser ailments.
entries.zh:
第二卷——动物 

本卷主要介绍动物在各种药物配制中的用途。从母乳、胆汁，到磨碎的骨髓，甚至脑组织，都被列为治疗各种重病和轻症的重要材料。

entries.en:
Book III - Oils, Potions and Brews 

A kind of extension to the first two books in the series. This book covers old ground, as well as going into deeper detail on the preparation of various healing liquids. It also introduces new, more advanced, and sometimes esoteric methods. Many ingredients for the brews and oils it lists can not be found on the surface and are totally unfamiliar.
entries.zh:
第三卷——药油、药水与煎剂 

这本书可算前两卷的补充。它重述部分旧知识，也更深入地讲解各种疗愈药液的配制，并介绍了更先进、偶尔也更玄奥的新方法。所列煎剂和药油中的许多材料在地表无处可寻，你也从未听说过。

entries.en:
Book IV = Amulets 

A list of unknown legendary objects with healing proprieties.
A wild tangent is taken in the series here as it seems to primarily deal with thaumaturgic principles. Very little of it can be understood, other than the names and properties of various rare or totally unknown substances. The processes and methods it details are too far fetched to be accurate, perhaps the author wrote it in his old age, or perhaps it was meant as a work of fiction.
entries.zh:
第四卷——护符 

本卷罗列了一些具有疗愈功效的神秘传说器物。
这一卷突然偏离了丛书原有的方向，似乎主要讨论异能原理。除了各种稀有乃至完全未知的物质名称与特性，几乎没什么能看懂。所述步骤与方法荒诞得难以置信，或许是作者晚年的作品，也可能本来就是虚构故事。

entries.en: A tattered padded cloth gambeson.
entries.zh: 一件破烂的夹棉布甲。

entries.en: A pair of hardened leather vambraces in poor condition.
entries.zh: 一对硬化皮革护臂，状态很差。

entries.en: A badly worn leather cap.
entries.zh: 一顶磨损严重的皮帽。

entries.en: A detailed log of various materials being delivered and dispatched. The script and some of the spelling seem very unusual. What you assume must be dates have a format that you can't make sense of.
entries.zh: 一份详细记录各种材料收发情况的账簿。字迹和某些拼写十分古怪。你猜测其中一些内容是日期，却看不懂它们的格式。

entries.en: Consignment has arrived, I must find a suitable place and begin work. Finally I can resume living with a vague semblance of decency. I cannot stand this filth any longer, I've been living like an animal.
entries.zh: 货物已经送到，我必须找个合适的地方开始工作。终于能过回稍微像样一点的生活了。我再也受不了这般污秽，我简直一直活得像头野兽。

entries.en:
They lose the will to live without their bodies. They seem completely bound to their mortal remains. Is it just because of their lesser minds? I have attempted to sustain one with nothing left but th...

Gods below, what am I doing? It is horrifying. Sometimes it is as if I suddenly wake to realise that I am fuelled by rage, as if I hold these poor souls responsible for what has befallen me.
entries.zh:
失去肉体后，它们就失去了生存的意志。它们似乎完全受自身遗骸束缚。仅仅是因为心智低下吗？我试着让一个只剩下……的个体继续存在。

地下的诸神啊，我究竟在做什么？太可怕了。有时我仿佛突然醒来，才发现驱使我的是愤怒，仿佛我把自己的遭遇都怪罪在这些可怜的灵魂身上。

entries.en: I think my illness has worsened since coming here, I often feel confused, as if battling conflicting thoughts. My temper keeps getting the better of me, an aggressive trait I never knew I posessed. Perhaps it is simply a response to all that has happened. Even so it scares me, I don't recognise myself. I must make a greater effort to retain my composure.
entries.zh: 来到这里后，我的病似乎更重了。我时常感到混乱，仿佛彼此矛盾的念头在脑海里交战。我总是控制不住脾气，变得富于攻击性，从前我从不知道自己有这一面。也许这只是经历了这些事后的反应。可我还是害怕，我认不出自己了。我必须更努力地保持冷静。

entries.en: So far results are disappointing. I suppose I should have expected as much after the initial dramatic progress. I am seeing some improvement but I feel as though I need a change in direction to really go further. If only poor Papin was still with me, exchanging thoughts with him would benefit me greatly.
entries.zh: 目前的结果令人失望。最初取得惊人的进展后，或许就该料到会这样。虽然仍有些改进，但我觉得必须换个方向才能真正走得更远。要是可怜的帕平还在就好了，与他交流想法一定大有裨益。

entries.en: I feel a growing resentment for Thaven. On the one hand I wish to please him, to impress him, but such thoughts then lead me to anger. I once believed there was friendship between us, now I think perhaps it was based on naught but common interests. His disregard for all things other than his single minded purpose has hurt us, it has put us all in difficulty and danger. I was always feared, but I was also respected. To be driven from my own home by peasants!
entries.zh: 我对塞文的怨恨越来越深。一方面我想取悦他，让他刮目相看，可这样的念头又让我愤怒。我曾以为我们之间有友谊，如今却觉得，那也许只是共同利益的产物。他眼里只有自己的目标，其他一切都不在乎。这伤害了我们，让所有人都陷入困境与危险。人们一直畏惧我，却也尊重我。我竟被一群农民赶出了自己的家！

entries.en: Hamon has obviously cast aside our agreement. He's sending far too many down here and I've lost all contact with him. What is he trying to do? One of these wretches confessed that he was told to seek treasure. Someone will notice all these missing people. And what if one finds me while I sleep? I no longer feel safe here, I have locked the doors but I should venture further and look for something more secure.
entries.zh: 哈蒙显然把我们的约定抛在了脑后。他送下来的人太多了，我也完全联系不上他。他到底想做什么？有个倒霉鬼承认，有人让他下来寻宝。这么多人失踪，总会有人察觉。万一有人趁我睡着时找到我怎么办？这里已让我觉得不安全。我锁上了门，但还是该继续深入，找个更稳妥的地方。

entries.en: A log of work orders, it seems as though many people were involved in completing them. Most of the names seem strange and many items are described with words you've never seen before.
entries.zh: 一本工作单记录。看来许多人参与了这些工作的完成。大多数名字都很陌生，许多物品的描述中也用了你从未见过的词语。

entries.en: A long list of people undergoing treatment of often grevious wounds. Many of the injuries appear to be bites and lacerations, presumably resulting from the attacks of some sort of animal.
entries.zh: 一份长长的伤员名单，多数伤势严重。许多伤口似乎是咬伤和撕裂伤，可能来自某种动物的袭击。

entries.en:
Sal,

I will, though hurry back, he went for Fabon at inspection causing him to cry out. No harm was done but to his pride, his high pitch drew much laughter. He's declared him unfit for duty, and by the way he talks, we fear he may have more permanent plans. 

Taren
entries.zh:
萨尔：

我会的，不过你快回来吧。检查时，它扑向法邦，把他吓得叫了出来。除了自尊，倒没伤着什么；他那尖叫声逗得大家笑个不停。他已经宣布它不适合值勤，听他那口气，我们担心他还打算一劳永逸地处理这事。 

塔伦

entries.en: A catalogue exhaustively describing many common and unremarkable plants in great detail. It's hard to imagine why anyone would undertake such a pointless endeavour.
entries.zh: 一份目录，极其详尽地描述了许多普通而不起眼的植物。很难想象为什么有人会去做这么无聊的事。

entries.en: A list of people assigned guard duty here. The same names are repeated, signed and stamped over and over again. Occasionally a name disappears suddenly and is replaced by another, no reason for this is noted.
entries.zh: 一份此处的值勤人员名单。相同的名字一再出现，反复签字盖章。偶尔有个名字突然消失，被另一个替代，却没有注明原因。

entries.en: Letter
entries.zh: 信件

entries.en:
Dearest Mathis,

Elara has disappeared. Many have gone missing of late but bandits in the area are not uncommon. Elara however does not travel, why would they have taken her? I dread to think what they might do to her. I thought of a ransom and so, I am ashamed to admit, I thought of you. But there have been no requests for ransom, just more and more missing. I assume news of these events has not reached Ardent, it has been long since we've seen a proctor. What am I to do dear cousin? Will you at least advise me?

Tessa
entries.zh:
亲爱的马西斯：

艾拉拉失踪了。近来有许多人失踪，但这一带闹匪也不是什么稀奇事。可艾拉拉从不远行，他们为什么要抓她？我不敢想他们会怎么对她。我想到赎金，所以，说来惭愧，我想到了你。可是没人索要赎金，只有越来越多的人失踪。我猜消息还没有传到阿登，我们已经很久没见过执法官了。亲爱的表兄，我该怎么办？至少给我些建议好吗？

泰莎

entries.en: Book
entries.zh: 书

entries.en: In response to our surprising failure we've installed Naiss's ingenious mechanism as a final precaution against intrusion. It can only be operated by those with knowledge of its workings. Simply press all the outer buttons but never two near eachother in sequence before operating it. This will surely keep them out no matter how smart they are.
entries.zh: 鉴于我们出乎意料的失守，现已安装奈斯设计的巧妙机关，作为防止入侵的最后一道保险。只有熟知原理的人才能操作。启动前，只需按遍外围的所有按钮，但绝不能连续按下相邻的两个。这样一来，无论它们多聪明，都一定进不来。

entries.en: Darrin, please inform Naiss that he's an idiot. Only a handful of the soldiers are able to reliably operate the mechanism without incident. They don't even understand what they're doing wrong, clearly it is not as simple as he'd have us believe. We've had several incidents already and I'm now having to teach precautions to avoid being burned.
entries.zh: 达林，请转告奈斯，他是个蠢货。只有少数士兵能稳定地操作那机关而不出事。他们甚至不知道自己错在哪里，可见事情根本不像他声称的那样简单。我们已经出了好几起事故，现在我还得教大家如何避免被烧伤。

entries.en:
Taren,

 Leave my key in Han's care. If you're called before I return, I pity any man who try take it.

Sal
entries.zh:
塔伦：

 如果我回来之前有人召你走，就把钥匙交给汉看着。谁敢去拿，我都替他可怜。

萨尔

entries.en: The Canine Conductor
entries.zh: 驭犬者

entries.en:
[algn=2][scrp=i]How to Form an Unbreakable Bond with Your Hounds[scrp=n][algn=0]

Handlers and trainers of canines refer to this book for techniques to enhance the connection between humans and their hounds. It details training methods and rituals that ensure obedience and loyalty.
entries.zh:
[algn=2][scrp=i]如何与你的猎犬建立牢不可破的纽带[scrp=n][algn=0]

养犬人和驯犬师借助本书所述技巧，加深人与猎犬之间的联系。书中详述了培养服从与忠诚的训练方法和仪式。

entries.en: That idiot and his thugs are still sending many down here. I must admit I am impressed by his methods, in some ways he is less a fool than he appears. I must take advantage of this and resume my research while I still can. I've yet to find a place where I w-
entries.zh: 那个蠢货和他的打手还在不断把人送下来。我得承认，他的手段令我印象深刻，某些方面，他并不像看起来那么傻。我必须趁还有机会，好好利用这一点，恢复研究。我还没找到一个能让我——

entries.en: I have been informed that the conservers have spies amongst us. Despite our differences I cannot imagine that they're looking to harm us, or even impede our mission here. I cannot in truth see much reason to prevent them from knowing of our progress, I am inclined to just let them get their information rather than waste resources and encourage doubt and suspicion amongst us.
entries.zh: 有人告知我，守旧派在我们之中安插了密探。尽管双方有分歧，我却不相信他们想伤害我们，甚至不认为他们想妨碍我们在此的任务。说实话，我看不出有什么理由阻止他们了解进展。与其浪费资源、助长内部的猜忌与怀疑，我更愿意让他们得到消息。

entries.en: This place begins to intrigue me. Thaven understands more things than I imagined. What if he is right? It would change everything. How could we be so ignorant? If I had more time I believe I would undertake his mission. I wonder what changes he has brought about by now with these discoveries. These are important times, I would live to see them.
entries.zh: 这个地方开始引起我的兴趣了。塞文懂得的比我想象的更多。如果他是对的呢？一切都会改变。我们怎么会如此无知？若我还有时间，我想我会接过他的使命。不知道凭这些发现，他如今已带来了怎样的变化。这是个重要的时代，我真想活着见证。

entries.en:
I'm sitting in a tavern, something I have not done a long time. Alas it is quite empty and all the drink has spoiled long ago.


These people cannot have been so different from us. And yet some things are very strange. There are lamps and even fires that never burn out, I do not understand the source of their power. These walls echo with the souls of the long dead but beneath that I sense something else, like a far reaching presence, it is faint but everywhere, and very strange. Could this be the mythical Guardian? Or even Thaven's Spellgiver?
entries.zh:
我正坐在一家酒馆里，已经很久没这么做了。可惜这里空无一人，酒也早已变质。


这些人与我们不会有太大差别。可有些东西实在奇怪：灯盏，甚至炉火，永远不会熄灭，我不明白它们的力量从何而来。墙壁间回荡着久逝者的灵魂，但在那之下，我还感到另一种东西，仿佛一个延伸到远方的存在，微弱却无处不在，十分诡异。这会是传说中的守护者吗？还是塞文所说的赐术者？

entries.en:
I've been avoiding relations with my subjects as it could become a serious impediment to my work. I did not imagine that I would miss human contact so much. Papin could have carried my legacy but I now treasure his company and friendship more than anything. Even so I deeply regret the loss of a lifetime of imparted knowledge and teachings. If I were to succeed poor Papin would never truly have reaped the benefits of his apprenticeship but he accepted this and was always eager and gratef-

-s too late now, I must not dwell on it any longer.
entries.zh:
我一直避免与实验对象建立感情，以免严重妨碍工作。我没想到自己会如此怀念与人的接触。帕平原本能继承我的事业，如今我却觉得他的陪伴与友谊比什么都珍贵。即便如此，毕生传授的知识与教诲就此失落，仍让我深感遗憾。假如我成功了，可怜的帕平便永远无法真正享受到拜师的成果，但他接受了这一点，始终热切而感——

——如今已经太迟了，我不能再沉溺其中。

entries.en: I discovered a truly miraculous substance. It produces a faint light and a pungent odour, when I touched it a wound on my hand I acquired during my cuttings healed rapidly. It was astounding. I have experimented with it but so far it has proven ineffective against my illness. If only I could find more. It was well hidden, obviously it is something of great value. I thought perhaps the lamps contained this substance but I was unable to break one open, when I finally removed one from the wall it gradually lost its light.
entries.zh: 我发现了一种真正神奇的物质。它发出微光，气味刺鼻。我碰到它后，手上解剖时留下的伤口迅速愈合，令人惊叹。我做了一些实验，但目前它对我的病毫无作用。要是能再找到些就好了。它藏得很隐秘，显然价值不菲。我原以为灯里也有这种物质，却怎么都敲不开。终于从墙上拆下一盏后，它的光逐渐消失了。

entries.en: Clearly this was once a place of military activity, but who were they fighting? Were we once at war with these people? It would seem we won. How could such events be completely erased from our history? Thaven believes that somewhere down here lies the true source of our power. I cannot make sense of any of this, I wish now that I had been less dismissive of Thaven's theories.
entries.zh: 这里显然曾是一处军事据点，可他们在与谁交战？我们曾与这些人打过仗吗？看起来是我们赢了。这样的事件怎么会从历史中被抹得一干二净？塞文相信，我们力量的真正源头就藏在地下某处。我完全理不清头绪，现在真希望自己当初没有那么轻视他的理论。

entries.en: This log is filled with detailed reports of people violating certain rules. Most of these rules are obviously aimed at preventing the entry of intruders. They are strict and elaborate to the point of seeming a product of paranoia.
entries.zh: 这本日志详细记录了人们违反各项规定的情况。大多数规定显然是为了阻止外人进入，其严苛与繁复程度几乎像是出于偏执。

entries.en: A mouldy old scroll that's too damaged to read.
entries.zh: 一卷发霉的旧卷轴，破损得无法辨读。

entries.en: A mouldy old scroll that's too damaged to read.
entries.zh: 一卷发霉的旧卷轴，破损得无法辨读。

entries.en: Old scroll
entries.zh: 旧卷轴

entries.en: I have been informed that the conservers have spies amongst us. Despite our differences I cannot imagine that they're looking to harm us, or even impede our mission here. I cannot in truth see much reason to prevent them from knowing of our progress, I am inclined to just let them get their information rather than waste resources and encourage doubt and suspicion amongst us.
entries.zh: 有人告知我，守旧派在我们之中安插了密探。尽管双方有分歧，我却不相信他们想伤害我们，甚至不认为他们想妨碍我们在此的任务。说实话，我看不出有什么理由阻止他们了解进展。与其浪费资源、助长内部的猜忌与怀疑，我更愿意让他们得到消息。

entries.en: The Kingdom Beyond
entries.zh: 彼方王国

entries.en:
The Kingdom Beyond by Alisian Dayen.

In a brutal battle a knight named Buto is trapped behind enemy lines. He fights valiantly but is overwhelmed and captured. His captors demand strategic information, but his interrogator is kind to him and tries to win him over to their cause. Buto is loyal to his king and will not give them anything of import. In time however a friendship is established between him and his interrogator. One day the interrogator reveals himself as the very king of Buto's captors and tells him that through their exchanges he has learned much to gain an advantage in the war. He offers Buto his freedom, so that he can return to his king and that one day they might meet again in battle. As Buto leaves his prison he sees the people he would assail in a new light and is disheartened, he knows too that he may be received by his own people as a traitor. And so he asks if he can stay and lead a simple life. The king consents, knowing that he will grow to love and cherish his new home and people, a formidable warrior who will rise to protect them.
entries.zh:
《彼方王国》，阿利西安·戴恩著。

一场惨烈的战斗中，名叫布托的骑士被困在敌后。他英勇奋战，终因寡不敌众而被俘。敌人逼问战略情报，但审讯者待他和善，试图劝他认同敌方的事业。布托忠于自己的国王，不肯透露重要消息。然而，随着时间推移，他与审讯者建立了友谊。一天，审讯者表明自己正是敌国国王，并说通过两人的交流，他已获得许多有利于战局的信息。他愿意还布托自由，让他回到自己的国王身边，日后或许还能在战场重逢。布托走出牢房时，对自己将要攻击的人民有了新的认识，不由得灰心丧气；他也知道，故国之人可能会把自己视作叛徒。于是他请求留下来，过一种简单的生活。国王答应了，因为他知道，这位强大的战士终将爱护自己的新家园与人民，并为保护他们挺身而出。

entries.en:
A Handbook for Navigators

The pages of this book are filled with essential knowledge for plotting your course across unfamiliar lands. It uncovers the art of mapmaking, from the use of compasses to triangulating positions using either the sun, moon, stars, or even simply identifying features in the terrain helping to develop the artistic and technical skills necessary to craft accurate and visually appealing maps. With beautifully detailed illustrations and carefully written instructions, this book would clearly make a useful companion for anyone interested in learning the art of cartography.
entries.zh:
领航者手册

本书介绍了在陌生土地上规划路线的必备知识。它讲解制图的艺术，从使用罗盘，到借助日月星辰进行三角定位，乃至单纯辨识地貌特征，帮助读者掌握绘制准确而美观的地图所需的艺术与技术。书中插图精美细致，说明用心，显然很适合想学习地图绘制的人。

entries.en: The Art and Science of Mapmaking
entries.zh: 地图绘制的艺术与科学

entries.en: A proctor! Just as I feared, and yet I grew complacent. She was well prepared, obviously she had some idea of what to expect, it was only luck that she didn't kill me. I cannot stay here, I must hide and prepare defences. I don't know how I will be able to continue my work. The proctor would have made an excellent subject, a shame I had to kill her so. I will leave her here to impede any who would pursue me.
entries.zh: 一个执法官！果然如我所惧，可我竟还是松懈了。她准备充分，显然对这里的情况有所了解，我没被她杀死纯属侥幸。我不能再待在这里，必须藏起来，布置防御。我不知道该如何继续研究。她本来会是个绝佳的实验对象，可惜我不得不这样杀了她。我会把她留在这里，阻拦追赶我的人。

entries.en: One of my subjects found a most remarkable weapon and escaped, making quick work of anything in his path. I was surprised by his ability to guard his mind against me, I tracked his escape for some time but he then completely vanished from my senses. How did he do that? Who is he?
entries.zh: 有个实验对象找到了一件极不寻常的武器，逃走了，沿途一切都被他轻易扫除。他竟能守住心智抵抗我，这令我惊讶。我追踪了他一阵子，随后他便从我的感知中彻底消失。他是怎么做到的？他究竟是谁？

entries.en: I have found a helmet which blocks my power when I wear it. Perhaps more importantly it shielded me from the noise of other minds, that presence that has haunted me since I came here was gone. Shortly after donning it I fell asleep, I am certain it was not its power that did this but the calm that came over me, I had not slept so well in quite some time. I feel certain now that it is this presence that causes unrest and aggressiveness in my subjects, clearly it is malevolent.
entries.zh: 我找到了一顶头盔，戴上后便无法使用异能。更重要的或许是，它隔绝了其他心智的喧嚣。自我来到这里就一直纠缠我的那个存在，也消失了。戴上没多久，我便睡着了。我确信这并非头盔的力量所致，而是因为终于安静下来；我已经很久没有睡得那么好了。现在我确信，正是那个存在令实验对象躁动而富于攻击性。它显然怀有恶意。

entries.en: I am certain that Zuiek is importing contraband goods. We have searched his lodgings and the glass workshop on several occasions but we never find anything, not even a hiding place he might use. That old toad has been here longer than any of us and he thinks he can outsmart us. I must be missing something, but what?
entries.zh: 我确信祖伊克在走私违禁品。我们多次搜查他的住处和玻璃作坊，却总是一无所获，连可能的藏匿处都找不到。那只老蛤蟆待在这里的时间比谁都久，他以为自己能耍得我们团团转。我一定漏掉了什么，可究竟是什么？

entries.en:
Zuiek,

As you know I have placed a very special order with you. Given the significant payment I have given you I expect prompt delivery, why have I yet to hear from you?
entries.zh:
祖伊克：

如你所知，我向你订购了一件十分特殊的东西。我已经付了可观的报酬，自然希望尽快收到货。为什么至今还没有你的消息？

entries.en: Some of the soldiers are trying to intimidate me into giving them certain items. I made the mistake of trying to explain why we limit their use, clearly they do not agree and now they dislike me more. Should I inform the captain? I see no choice that will not lead me to more trouble.
entries.zh: 有些士兵试图恐吓我，让我交出某些物品。我犯了个错，竟想解释为什么要限制使用。显然他们并不认同，现在反而更讨厌我了。该向队长报告吗？我看不出有什么选择不会招来更多麻烦。

entries.en:
What terrible place is this? A thunderous voice shouts unintelligibly in my mind, as though trying to command me with wordless urgency. It's as though it wants to both urge me and sooth me, I am terrified that I may succumb to its will. This strange helm is my only respite, but it leaves me vulnerable.

There is also a constant wailing of ancient restless spirits, has this presence been keeping them from finding peace?
entries.zh:
这是什么可怕的地方？一个雷鸣般的声音在我脑海中高喊，我听不懂它，仿佛它正以无言的急迫向我下令。它似乎既想催促我，又想安抚我，我害怕自己会屈从于它的意志。只有这顶奇异的头盔能让我喘息，但戴着它又会使我无力自保。

那些古老而不安的灵魂也在不停哀嚎。难道正是这个存在让它们无法安息？

entries.en: Dassin, keep a watchful eye over the scribes and the archivists, especially the archivists. There have been many reports of things being taken and hidden away. We must be thorough.
entries.zh: 达辛，盯紧抄写员和档案员，尤其是档案员。已经有许多报告说，有人把东西拿走藏了起来。我们必须彻查。

entries.en: Burn, burn it all! A lifetime watching over things that I must now quietly consign to the fires. For what? The teachings of a monstrous traitor? The sorry truth is that no one is willing now to admit they were wrong, too much was invested, it couldn't be for nothing. And so we go forth and burn the path behind us, let blind hope be our guide.
entries.zh: 烧吧，全烧光吧！我守护了一辈子的东西，如今却得默默把它们投入火中。为了什么？一个可怕叛徒的教诲？可悲的真相是，谁都不肯承认自己错了。投入得太多，怎能到头来一场空。于是我们继续前行，烧掉身后的道路，让盲目的希望指引我们。

entries.en: Our glorious hero is little more than a killer. Now that his deadly work is done he cares nothing for the consequences. Murder our gods so that we may be free. And lost. I will not forget who saved us from oblivion. We have been warned, far worse is coming and our demise is now inevitable.
entries.zh: 我们光荣的英雄，不过是个杀手。杀戮结束，他就再也不管后果。杀死我们的神，好让我们获得自由，也让我们迷失。我不会忘记是谁将我们从毁灭中拯救出来。警告已经给出，更可怕的东西正在逼近，如今我们的覆灭已无可避免。

entries.en:
Venerable Aderon, 

I understand that you are conflicted, but I must ask that you keep the voicing of your misgivings to within the council. You cannot hope to stop this now, you will only cause disquiet and potentially worse. Please, remember the responsibility that comes with your position.

Terschenn
entries.zh:
尊敬的阿德隆： 

我理解你的矛盾，但必须请你只在议会内部表达疑虑。现在你已不可能阻止此事，只会引发不安，甚至更坏的后果。请牢记，你的地位意味着怎样的责任。

特申

entries.en:
I have never been so terrified. I was attacked by a huge dreadful creature. A demon perhaps? I tried to control it, but though its mind felt completely unguarded, it was oblivious to my intrusion. I was only able to confuse it briefly and get away, I am defenceless against this thing. I dare not venture out again.

These dead guards, perhaps I could call them to action. I don't imagine they could do much against such a monster, but the distraction might cover my escape.
entries.zh:
我从未如此恐惧。一头庞大而可怕的生物袭击了我，也许是恶魔？我试图控制它，可它的心智虽然毫无防备，却对我的入侵浑然不觉。我只能短暂迷惑它，趁机逃脱。面对这东西，我根本无力抵抗，不敢再出去了。

这些死去的守卫，也许我能唤它们行动。我不觉得它们能对付那怪物，但或许能分散它的注意，掩护我逃走。

entries.en: When I took this oath I told myself my life no longer mattered. Now that courage, that sense of purpose, is fading fast. I look to the others for strength, but I find the same doubt in their eyes. They mocked us and now I see the truth of it. This is senseless.
entries.zh: 立下誓言时，我告诉自己，个人的性命已不再重要。可如今，那份勇气与使命感正在迅速消退。我想从同伴身上找到力量，却在他们眼中看到了同样的怀疑。他们曾嘲笑我们，如今我才明白那嘲笑不无道理。这一切毫无意义。

entries.en:
I fear I don't have long left. I have abandoned my efforts to escape death. It was foolish, and yet I have accomplished so much. I must try to send word to Thaven, he will see the importance of my work, even though he is concerned with other matters.

I believed Thaven's pursuits to be as hollow as my own, a stubborn refusal to accept bitter truths. After what I've seen here anything seems possible. I will spend the rest of my days discovering what I can, I can still be of help.
entries.zh:
恐怕我时日无多了。我已经放弃逃脱死亡的尝试。那很愚蠢，可我也确实取得了许多成果。我必须设法给塞文传信。尽管他关注的是别的事情，也会明白我的研究有多重要。

我曾以为塞文的追求与我的一样空洞，只是不肯接受残酷真相的固执。可在这里见识过这些之后，一切似乎都有可能。我会用余下的日子尽力探索，我仍然能够有所帮助。

entries.en:
Venerable Kaeylen,

Forgive me if I speak so directly, but I won't hold my tongue given what I'm witness to. It cannot be what you intended, they are taking and burning everything! We will be left completely in the dark of our past, our mistakes, the threats that we've yet to face. No good can come of this, and those who bring it about seek only to rule absolute through the power of ignorance.

I implore you to see the fault in this and put an end to it. This is not how we embark on a new path, we head towards nothing but our ultimate demise.

Your humble servant,
Aderon
entries.zh:
尊敬的凯伦：

请原谅我直言，可面对亲眼所见的一切，我无法沉默。这绝不该是你的本意，他们在拿走并焚烧所有东西！我们将对自己的过去、犯过的错误以及尚未面对的威胁一无所知。这不会带来任何好处，促成此事的人只想借无知的力量取得绝对统治。

我恳求你看清其中的错误，制止这一切。这不是踏上新的道路，而是在走向最终的毁灭。

你谦卑的仆人，
阿德隆

entries.en:
Orenn,

I commend you for intercepting this correspondence, you have been of great service.

It pains me to see him so misguided, his only fault is to believe too strongly in the quality of our spirit. This delusion of his and his very conviction is too dangerous, we cannot risk the harm he would do if he were to infect others with his ideas.

My heart is heavy with the burden of it, but I must ask that y-
entries.zh:
奥伦：

感谢你截获这封信，你立了大功。

看到他如此误入歧途，我深感痛心。他唯一的过错，便是过于相信我们精神中的美好品质。他的幻想与坚定信念太过危险，我们不能冒险让这些思想感染旁人，造成伤害。

这份重担压得我心情沉重，可我仍必须请你——

entries.en: That silly nurse touching everything! She accidentally opened my secret study. All I could think to do is send her away in a hurry. I think she may have gotten entirely the wrong idea.
entries.zh: 那个蠢护士，什么都要碰！她竟意外打开了我的秘密书房。我只能急忙把她打发走。我想她可能完全误会了。

entries.en: Who needs The Guardian when you have the great Torris? What do I expect? To be hailed as a hero? If they knew what I attempted, they'd have my head.
entries.zh: 有伟大的托里斯在，谁还需要守护者？我究竟在期待什么？被奉为英雄吗？要是他们知道我尝试做了什么，准会砍下我的脑袋。

entries.en:
I have no more time, and find I cannot leave without knowing. I will give my life, nothing else matters to me now.

I was not able to acquire a stronger source of power, so I must be quick. Should I disappear forever behind this wall, then perhaps at least I will be remembered as the good physician, and not the madman.
entries.zh:
没有时间了，可我发现，不知道答案，我就无法离开。我愿付出生命，如今其他一切都已不再重要。

我没能弄到更强的能量来源，必须速战速决。如果我永远消失在这堵墙后，至少人们记住的也许还是一位好医生，而非一个疯子。

entries.en:
With breaths held we tread
You and me, hand in hand
Our gazes locked ahead
Upon this endless land

Where rivers flow
Under open skies
And slow they grow
But trees reach high
The beasts run wild
We'll hunt, and after
We'll make a child
To raise with laughter
entries.zh:
我们屏息而行
你我携手相伴
目光望向前方
那片无尽的原野

河水在那里流淌
天空辽阔晴朗
树木缓缓生长
终将高高向上
野兽自在奔跑
我们打猎，然后
迎来一个孩子
伴他欢笑成长

entries.en: I've finally received a reply from Thaven, and I regret that I wrote to him. We all know what he did, we all know what he's capable of. I can't trust him, if he's sending someone to me, I fear it will not be with good intentions.
entries.zh: 终于收到了塞文的回信，我却后悔写信给他了。我们都知道他做过什么，也知道他能做出什么。我不能信任他。如果他派人来找我，我怕那人不会怀着善意。

entries.en:
Dearest Corlian,

It is good to hear from you my old friend. I heard what had befallen you, but I knew you would not be so easily thwarted.

I am terribly sorry about Papin, I cannot imagine what a loss it is for you. I am sending someone to help you. I know you well, and I believe you will be greatly attuned.

Oh, the things we are discovering! I find myself struggling to keep to my purpose. It seems my theories were correct, but there is so much more to learn, so much I would never have guessed. I cannot wait to hear what a man with your insight has uncovered.

Be well my friend, I hope to see you soon.

Thaven
entries.zh:
亲爱的科利安：

收到你的来信真好，老朋友。我听说了你的遭遇，但我知道，你不会那么容易被击倒。

帕平的事让我十分难过，我无法想象这对你是多大的损失。我正派一个人去帮助你。我很了解你，相信你们一定会十分契合。

啊，我们发现的这些东西！我都快守不住自己原本的目标了。看来我的理论是对的，可还有太多值得了解、太多我从未料到的事物。我迫不及待地想听听，像你这样洞察敏锐的人究竟发现了什么。

保重，我的朋友。希望很快能见到你。

塞文

entries.en: A book containing a great many recipes for mixtures, salves and unguents. They seem to be all targeted at curing conditions that you've never heard of.
entries.zh: 一本收录了大量混合药剂、膏药与油膏配方的书。它们似乎全是用来治疗你从未听说过的病症。

entries.en: The situation is getting worse, now everyone seems to be amassing weapons and other combat gear. They fear that there will be violence, and want to be prepared. These items are being traded everywhere in secret, including some of our own equipment, which is greatly concerning. If someone were to impersonate the law they could cause some serious damage, and no doubt I'd be held responsible.
entries.zh: 情况越来越糟，现在所有人似乎都在囤积武器和其他战斗装备。他们害怕暴力冲突，想做好准备。这些物品到处都在暗中交易，其中甚至有我们的制式装备，着实令人担忧。要是有人冒充执法人员，可能酿成大祸，届时无疑会由我来承担责任。

entries.en:
As we are now invaded, I have asked my assistant to bring me what bodies of the creatures he can. I believe that through dissection I may be able to discover some weakness, some way we might combat them more effectively.


I have made a very strange discovery, through an upsetting accident. I found a kind of gland, filled with a highly adhesive fluid. It made contact with my hand, and within a short period of time the skin on my arm has changed. It has become tough, almost scaly. I am hoping the effect will wear off with time.


It has been several days and my skin has not improved. I've consulted the physician Theris, we've come to the conclusion that it must be an altering agent, changing the structure and function of living tissues it contacts.

Theris wants to know more, and we've decided to test small doses on those in his care who do not have long to live. I will persuade Elko to go below and fetch more, where many of the creatures can now be found.


The glands seem to have many varied effects! In some subjects we noticed nothing but mild disfiguration, sometimes with mild adverse effects, but in others we've noticed such things as an increase in strength, or a capacity for more rapid movements. The changes are small, so we cannot be certain, more tests are needed.


We've now had two serious accidents and we must stop. We noticed some fleeting changes in behaviour, but now we've had a second subject lose all reason and suddenly act as a trapped animal.
entries.zh:
如今我们遭到入侵，我让助手尽可能带些那些生物的尸体来。我相信，通过解剖，也许能发现某种弱点，让我们更有效地对抗它们。


一次令人不安的意外，带来了十分奇怪的发现。我找到一种腺体，里面充满黏性极强的液体。液体碰到我的手后，短短一会儿，手臂上的皮肤便发生了变化，变得坚韧，几乎像是长出了鳞片。我希望这种影响会随时间消退。


几天过去，皮肤仍没有好转。我咨询了医生瑟里斯，我们认为这必定是一种改造物质，会改变所接触的活体组织的结构与功能。

瑟里斯想进一步了解，于是我们决定，在他照顾的那些时日无多的人身上试用小剂量。我会说服艾尔科下去再取一些，如今下面有许多这种生物。


这些腺体的作用竟如此多样！一些实验对象只有轻微的外貌畸变，有时伴随轻微不适；另一些却出现了力量增强或动作加快等变化。变化很小，我们还不能确定，需要更多实验。


我们已经出了两起严重事故，必须停止。此前曾观察到短暂的行为变化，如今又有第二个实验对象彻底丧失理智，突然像被困的野兽一样发狂。

entries.en:
Captain Renis,

I have received your initial report. I appreciate that you did not try to draw conclusions, but it is clear that the intent of the transgression was to sell crystals that would go unused by means of the device. In response to this the supply of crystals will be more strictly regulated. Every use and transport must be logged and new crystals will not be supplied until exhausted ones have been returned in parity.

It is requested that you further question your men based on this information and see if potential buyers had already been approached and if they can be identified.

I await further communications.

Supervisor Seredin
entries.zh:
雷尼斯队长：

我已收到你的初步报告。你没有妄下结论，这一点值得肯定。不过很明显，违规者是想借助该装置，出售那些因而不必消耗的水晶。为此，水晶供应将受到更严格的管制。每次使用和转运都必须记录，只有等量交回耗尽的水晶后，才会补发新的。

请根据这些信息进一步盘问你的部下，查明他们是否已经接触潜在买家，以及能否确认买家身份。

等待你的后续报告。

督查塞雷丁

entries.en:
Captain Renis,

I write in regard to the recent incident with your missing guards. There will be inquiries about discipline, but for now all efforts should be directed at finding out where the device comes from and who made it. They believe the device has origins within your jurisdiction. You will be leading the investigation as you are deemed best equipped to do so. This is a matter of the highest priority. The item will be left with you for the purpose of your investigation. Guard it well, it is extremely dangerous. I cannot stress this enough.

Someone should have already come to reclaim the crystal by now. Do not concern yourself with the provenance of that, it will be handled internally.

They expect a prompt report on the interrogation of your men. Don't be surprised if someone comes in to follow up on this and conducts further interrogations. It is assumed that you have suitable people in place who can ask the right questions about the origin of the device. If you do not, let me know and I will put you in contact with an agent of my own.

Be sure that if you uncover any item of a similar construction or any information you may deem pertinent you report on it immediately. I don't think I need to tell you to take no action, but only communicate your findings.

Supervisor Seredin
entries.zh:
雷尼斯队长：

此信有关近期你手下守卫失踪一事。纪律问题将另行调查，目前应集中一切力量，查明装置的来源和制造者。上面认为，该装置出自你的辖区。鉴于你最具备调查条件，此案由你负责，优先级最高。为便于调查，物品会留在你处。务必严加看管，它极其危险。这一点，无论怎样强调都不为过。

现在应该已有专人前来收回水晶。你不必追查水晶的来源，此事将由内部处理。

上面要求尽快收到对你部下的审讯报告。如果有人前来跟进并进一步审讯，不必惊讶。我们认为，你手下应当有合适的人，能够就装置来源问出关键问题。如果没有，请告诉我，我会安排自己的一名探员与你联系。

若发现任何构造相似的物品，或任何你认为相关的信息，务必立即报告。我想无需提醒，你只应汇报发现，不要擅自行动。

督查塞雷丁

entries.en: A group must have stayed in hiding, and once we were almost all gone they raided the armouries. I assume they killed an officer to gain access. Many were killed, but our attempts to stop them were ultimately futile. I was backed into this room and they blocked the door. They did not see I was carrying this mask.
entries.zh: 一定有一伙人一直藏着，等我们几乎撤光后，便袭击了军械库。我猜他们杀死了一名军官，才得以进入。虽然杀死了不少人，我们最终还是没能阻止他们。我被逼进这个房间，他们堵住了门，却没发现我带着这副面具。

entries.en: It has been some time now, I don't know how long. I don't think anyone will come for me. Are the other all dead? This mask will sustain me for some time, but I fear it will only prolongue my suffering.
entries.zh: 已经过去一阵子了，具体多久，我不知道。我想不会有人来救我。其他人都死了吗？这副面具还能让我支撑一段时间，可我担心它只会延长我的痛苦。

entries.en:
These golems have proven an impassable barrier for me, I must turn back. I was shocked and dismayed to see them animate. At first I thought them to be lifeless constructs, a product of magics that I cannot fathom, and yet I sense something from them. Being versed in necromancy as I am, I fear these may be the result of something horrible, far worse than the practices of my art.

What if all that I see here is explained by the harvesting souls as a source of power? Minds reduced and locked in the eternal torment of serving some mundane purpose. The notion is frightful.
entries.zh:
这些魔像成了我无法逾越的障碍，我必须回头。看到它们活动起来，我震惊而沮丧。起初我以为它们是没有生命的造物，由我无法理解的魔法驱动，可我却从它们身上感到了什么。即使我精通死灵术，也害怕它们出自某种可怕之事，比我所行之术还要邪恶得多。

如果这里的一切，都是靠收割灵魂作为力量来源呢？心智被削弱、被囚禁，在永恒的折磨中为某种凡俗用途效劳。这个念头令人胆寒。

entries.en: I feel almost certain that Spellgiver and Corruptor are one and the same, condemned for atrocities, corrupting mortal souls. If this is true then Thaven's quest is folly. We did well to refuse our past and abandon such dark practices. I would hope that Thaven too might reach this conclusion, but I fear otherwise, and that he must be stopped. I now regret having sent word to him, he cannot save me anyway.
entries.zh: 我几乎可以肯定，赐术者与腐化者是同一个存在，因犯下暴行、腐化凡人灵魂而遭到谴责。若果真如此，塞文的追求便是愚行。我们摒弃过去、放弃那些黑暗手段，是正确的。我希望塞文也能得出这个结论，却担心他不会，那就必须阻止他。我如今后悔给他传信了，反正他也救不了我。

entries.en: Many now come to our doors. I suppose they wish to be prepared for what's ahead. It is good to see fresh blood, but I am concerned by the implications of their selfish purpose. That is not what we're here for.
entries.zh: 如今有许多人登门。我想他们是希望为前路做好准备。看到新鲜血液令人欣慰，可他们自私的动机及其影响让我担忧。我们在此并不是为了这个。

entries.en: I woke to terrible screams. Who could sleep through that? Edrian, my neighbour, was never found. All that's left of him is the blood in his bathroom. They say they are now amongst us. How could this happen? There are rumors that they were let through deliberately, but I cannot believe that.
entries.zh: 我被可怕的尖叫惊醒。那样的叫声，谁能睡得着？邻居埃德里安一直没有找到，他留下的只有浴室中的血迹。他们说那些东西已经混进我们中间。怎么会这样？有传言说，有人故意放它们进来，可我不愿相信。

entries.en: It will be good to leave here, start anew. I feel torn between two worlds, and responsible for things that are beyond me. I have blindly deferred to the judgement of others, and just as blindly enforced their will. I find that I have no opinion of my own, I see no atrocities committed, no teachings imparted, just empty words and stubborn egos. How can we judge such things? Yes, I am eager to leave it all behind.
entries.zh: 离开这里，重新开始，会是件好事。我仿佛被夹在两个世界之间，还得为远超自己能力的事情负责。我盲目听从他人的判断，也同样盲目地执行他们的意志。现在才发现，我没有自己的见解。我看不见什么暴行，也听不见什么教诲，只有空洞的话语与固执的自我。我们凭什么评判这些事？是的，我迫切地想把这一切抛在身后。

entries.en: This appears to have been an alchemical treatise holding many recipes for the transmutation of materials and producing magical effects. A great many of its pages seem to have been torn out in a terrible hurry. What is left is written in words that are mostly beyond your comprehension.
entries.zh: 这似乎是一部炼金术论著，收录了许多转化材料、产生魔法效果的配方。大量书页像是在极度匆忙中被撕走了。剩下的内容，大多用你难以理解的词语写成。

entries.en:
[scrp=i]I'm sorry Stenris, but I'm going to leave the company.

This is not what we do. We challenged the mind, we asked the questions! Look at us now, acting out badly written lies, pretending nothing's wrong. I know you are being pressured, and probably under threat, but it is too much to bear. I used to be proud of what we do, but now all I feel as I stand on our stage is shame. I won't do it anymore.

I will seek other ways to reach people, perhaps I'll join the fight. I hope that you can find peace when this is all over.

Your friend who begs you will forgive him,
Athelin
entries.zh:
[scrp=i]对不起，斯滕里斯，我要离开剧团了。

这不是我们的事业。我们曾启发思考，提出质疑！看看现在，我们演着拙劣的谎言，装作一切如常。我知道你承受着压力，可能还受到了威胁，可这已让人无法忍受。我曾为我们的事业自豪，如今站在舞台上，却只感到羞耻。我不会再演下去了。

我会寻找别的方式唤醒人们，也许会加入抗争。希望这一切结束后，你能找到内心的平静。

恳求你原谅的朋友，
阿瑟林

entries.en: [scrp=i]Methis gave me and some others these rods. He says they're useless on their own, and he made us each swear to keep our rod and its crystal safe. If we're to find ourselves in danger and with no escape, then we should gather all in the same place, surround it with the rods and wait for help. He's not said much more, but we trust him well. I'll do my part.
entries.zh: [scrp=i]梅西斯给了我和其他几个人这些杆子。他说，单独一根毫无用处，还让我们每个人发誓，要保管好自己的杆子和水晶。如果遇到危险、无路可逃，就聚在同一处，用这些杆子围住那里，等待救援。他没再多说，但我们都很信任他。我会尽好自己的责任。

entries.en:
[scrp=i]Dear Themin,

I hope this letter finds you well and whole. I have heard of your foolhardy endeavours. Always a champion of the common people.

I am due to leave with the next group in five days. I would have sought you out, but with everything that's happening I had to settle for this letter. I hope to see you again soon, please do not risk everything for this dying city. 

I would have left word either way, but I'm afraid I must also warn you of a great danger. Amatine claims to have someone who can truly wake the sentries, and he intends to do it. You must stop him, no one else has the authority. If he is not stopped we will have another great threat upon us.

Yours,
Elenis
entries.zh:
[scrp=i]亲爱的塞明：

愿你收到此信时安然无恙。我听说了你那些鲁莽的行动。你总是为平民挺身而出。

五天后，我将随下一批人离开。本想去找你，可如今发生了这么多事，只能写这封信。希望不久后还能见到你。请别为了这座垂死的城市赌上一切。 

无论如何我本都会留信，可现在还必须提醒你一个重大危险。阿马廷声称，他找到了真正能够唤醒哨卫的人，而且打算付诸行动。你必须阻止他，别人没有这个权力。若不制止，我们将又多一个可怕的威胁。

你的，
埃莱尼斯

entries.en:
This journal is filled with diagrams of what look like strange organs, and some others you don't understand. It seems various fluids were being tested on fleshy tissues, most of the names are very unusual. On the last written page, there seem to be the author's dying words:

[scrp=i]I think I will die here. I can hear them at the door, scratching. I cannot escape.

Nephil, know that your concoction was entirely ineffective in deterring the monsters. I think we've got it all wrong, something else is driving them. I do not blame you, it was an honor to work with you, and I knew the risk I was taking. 

Please take care of Esthra.
entries.zh:
这本日志里画满了类似奇异器官的图解，还有一些完全看不懂的图案。作者似乎在用各种液体试验血肉组织，多数名称都十分陌生。最后一页写着的，似乎是作者的临终遗言：

[scrp=i]我想我会死在这里。我听到它们在门口抓挠，已经无路可逃。

奈菲尔，你得知道，你配的药剂完全没能驱退那些怪物。我想我们全弄错了，驱使它们的是别的东西。我不怪你，能与你共事是我的荣幸，我也清楚自己承担的风险。 

请照顾好埃丝拉。

entries.en: Thaven's lackey has reached me. {®Exanima.Unknown.HeShe} is not a bad sort, and a strong mind too. I do not sense nefarious intent, Thaven's offer of help at least seems true. It is strange to find some companionship after all this strife, the death of Papin and my own life slipping away spurred me into a compulsion to do something before the end, I never stopped to consider my actions. I hurt so many, and buried my guilt along with my grief.
entries.zh: 塞文的手下找到我了。{®Exanima.Unknown.HeShe}不是坏人，心智也很强。我没有察觉恶意，至少塞文愿意帮忙似乎是真心的。经历这么多磨难后，竟还能得到陪伴，这感觉很陌生。帕平的死与我自己不断流逝的生命，逼得我一心只想在终结前做点什么，从未停下来审视自己的行为。我伤害了那么多人，又把愧疚与悲痛一同埋藏。

entries.en:
I have encountered multiple times dead that were not raised by me. At first I thought I was forgetful, then I feared a necromancer with a talent to match my own was near. I wondered even if the fanciful myths of a Guardian who rules the dead could hold some truth. Now I am beset by a frightful notion, what if the dead, once awoken so, call to each other? Could it be a thing that spreads as does a plague? What if this is an art not merely forgotten and shunned by those of sensitive natures, but willfully concealed and forbidden for what it might do if left unchecked? Have I set something terrible in motion?

I wish it were not so, but I feel it is true. Is this to be my own fate as well? I will not let it be, I must find a way to escape this mortal shell, even if into oblivion. Perhaps if I truly succeed, I can undo some of the damage I've wrought.
entries.zh:
我已多次遇见并非由我唤起的亡者。起初以为自己健忘，后来又担心附近有个天赋不下于我的死灵术士。我甚至怀疑，关于统御亡者的守护者，那些荒诞传说是否有几分真实。如今一个可怕的念头纠缠着我：亡者一旦这样苏醒，是否会彼此呼唤？这会不会像瘟疫一样传播？这门技艺，难道并非只是被遗忘、被心肠柔软的人厌弃，而是因为放任其发展会招致灾难，才被有意隐瞒与禁止？我是否已经释放了某种可怕的东西？

我希望并非如此，可内心却觉得这是真的。这也会成为我的命运吗？我绝不允许。我必须找到逃离这具凡躯的办法，哪怕归于虚无。或许真正成功之后，我还能挽回自己造成的部分伤害。

entries.en: The Ways of the Thaumaturge - Part 1
entries.zh: 异能术士之道——第一卷

entries.en:
A book that introduces many concepts on the working of the thaumaturgic mind and presents various notions that seem at times in conflict and of little substance. Your impression is that the author was well informed, but did not truly understand what was divulged.

Thaumaturges are known to dwell in lonely towers and other remote residences. A common misconception is that it is to conduct their strange work away from prying eyes, but the truth is less sinister and less obvious. The mind of a thaumaturge is an intangible thing that extends far beyond their physical presence, it is as a great tree of connections to the world around them. When the lesser minds of multitudes move through this time and time again, they slowly chip away at its branches, weakening the thaumaturge as they do so. This is why they withdraw from company and seek isolation, so that their power is not drained away.

A notable exception to this are the great healers, they who live selflessly among those to which they might lend aid. The uncomfortable substance of their success is that as they care for those whom from illness pass to death, they form a bond, and from that bond, in the moment of passing, they take something to sustain them. This is little known and little discussed, as it could be seen in the wrong light and cast suspicion on these devoted servants of the community.
entries.zh:
这本书介绍了异能术士心智运作的许多概念，提出的各种见解有时似乎相互矛盾，也缺少实质内容。你觉得作者见闻广博，却并未真正理解所述知识。

异能术士常住在孤塔或其他偏僻居所。人们通常误以为，这是为了躲开窥探、进行奇异的工作；真正的原因却没那么阴暗，也没那么显而易见。术士的心智无形无质，延伸范围远超肉身，如同一棵与周围世界相连的大树。当众多弱小心智不断穿行其间，就会一点点磨损枝条，使术士变弱。因此他们远离人群、独自隐居，以免力量不断流失。

伟大的治疗者是个显著例外。他们无私地生活在需要帮助的人群中。其成就背后有个令人不安的事实：照顾那些因病走向死亡的人时，他们会与对方建立联结，并在对方逝去的瞬间，通过联结取走某种东西来维持自身。此事鲜有人知，也少被谈论，因为它可能遭到误解，让这些献身于众人的服务者受到怀疑。

entries.en: Torn Page
entries.zh: 撕下的书页

entries.en: Sashya said I am the most devoted wife she ever did meet. I give give give, he takes takes takes, she told me. I laughed and told her to hush, but I must admit the conversation left me with an uneasy feeling. It reminded me of the same old question I've been asking all these years. Why does he spend so much time alone in his blasted study? What does he do in there? Suspicion overcomes me at times. He is so evasive when questioned about it. I know he has secrets there, I just know it. I suppress my curiosity, as a dutiful wife must, but I do so wish he wouldn't keep things from me! I suppose I must accept I shall never know my husband fully, perhaps all men are this way...
entries.zh: 萨莎说，我是她见过最尽心尽责的妻子。她说，我只管付出、付出、再付出，而他只管索取、索取、再索取。我笑着叫她别说了，可不得不承认，这番话让我心里不安。它又勾起了这些年一直盘旋的问题：他为什么总是一个人躲在那该死的书房里？究竟在里面做什么？有时我忍不住起疑，每次问起，他都闪烁其词。我知道他在那里藏着秘密，我就是知道。尽职的妻子应该克制好奇，我也一直如此，可我真希望他别再瞒着我！也许我必须接受，自己永远无法完全了解丈夫。或许男人都是这样……

entries.en:
My work is near complete, I believe it will serve, but for this first vessel to come alive and be told to do as you wish I will need one more thing, a greater source of power. I believe in time I could find another way, but I know time is short and you already grow impatient. I am also concerned that rumours of what we attempt are spreading, and that some might be considering my involvement. If I am discovered I cannot hope to defend my actions.

Your humble and anonymous servant
entries.zh:
我的工作即将完成，我相信它能满足要求。不过，要让第一个容器活过来，听从命令照你的意愿行动，我还需要一样东西：更强的能量来源。若有时间，我相信能找到别的办法，但时间紧迫，你也已渐渐失去耐心。我还担心，我们所做之事的传闻正在扩散，有些人可能已怀疑到我。若被发现，我无法为自己的行为辩解。

你谦卑而不具名的仆人

entries.en: The Ways of the Thaumaturge - Part 2
entries.zh: 异能术士之道——第二卷

entries.en:
The 2nd part of a book discussing the workings of the minds of thaumaturges. This volume focuses on the strong connections formed between elevated minds and the traditions surrounding them.

An important figure in the life of a thaumaturge is their apprentice, though this relationship isn't always what it might seem. The minds of two thaumaturges can become highly attuned and learn to live and work in harmony. In unison they can be stronger, and when the time comes for the mentor to leave this world behind, their mind will not simply dissipate and be lost entirely, but continue to live in part through their apprentice. Thaumaturges consider their power to be a great gift that must not be lost, but passed on, treasured and nurtured.

The tradition of apprenticeship in the Order of Thaumaturges does not only concern the preservation of knowledge and power, but serves also to temper and check the spirits of those who would wield it. It is not only aptitude that is passed on, but the wisdom and temperament of the master. It is not unheard of that apprentices were ultimately deemed to be unfit for such talents and their apprenticeship abandoned.

It appears a final chapter was removed from this book, and in its place there is a brief warning against the dangers of bonds formed with beasts, of how these corrupt the mind of a thaumaturge, reducing them to savage beasts themselves.
entries.zh:
这是一部探讨异能术士心智运作的书的第二卷。本卷着重讲述高等心智之间的强大联结，以及相关传统。

学徒是术士生命中的重要人物，但师徒关系并不总如表面所见。两位术士的心智能够高度契合，学会和谐共处、协同工作。联手之时，他们会更强大；当导师离世，其心智也不会就此完全消散，而会有一部分通过学徒延续。术士认为，自己的力量是一份伟大的馈赠，不应任其失落，而应传承、珍惜、培育。

异能术士教团的师徒传统，不只是为了保存知识与力量，也为了磨炼和约束掌握力量之人的心性。传承的不仅是才能，还有导师的智慧与性情。学徒最终被认定不适合拥有这份天赋、因而被解除师徒关系，也并非没有先例。

本书最后一章似乎被撕去了，取而代之的是一段简短警告，告诫读者不要与野兽建立联结。这种联结会腐化术士的心智，使其自身也沦为凶残野兽。

entries.en: The time has come, my body is failing. I am certain now that Thaven must be stopped, but I cannot trust his agent to understand, and so I must complete one more dreadful act. I will try to use {®Exanima.Unknown.HimHer} as a vessel even as I die. It is not what I sought, but I believe it will work. I fear it won't be long before my mind and {®Exanima.Unknown.HisHers} are locked in a battle that neither may survive. I must make haste to reach the surface, find sympathetic ears among the Order and warn against the actions of Thaven, and my own.
entries.zh: 时候到了，我的身体正在衰竭。如今我确信，必须阻止塞文，但我不能相信他的代理人能够理解，所以我还得做最后一件可怕的事。即便身死，我也要尝试以{®Exanima.Unknown.HimHer}为容器。这并非我原本的目标，但我相信它能成功。恐怕用不了多久，我的心智就会与{®Exanima.Unknown.HisHers}陷入一场可能同归于尽的争斗。我必须尽快回到地表，在教团中找到愿意倾听的人，警告他们提防塞文的行径，也包括我自己的。

entries.en:
The memoirs and research of a necromancer named Corlian of Blackwell. He dedicated his later life to investigating the possibility of an existence beyond one tied to a physical and mortal form. This is known to some as transcendence, and believed to be the ultimate but elusive goal of the Order of Thaumaturges.

Corlian's research grew in fervour as he became afflicted by an illness from which he would not recover, leading him to acts and experiments that were ruthless in nature. Despite his grim efforts, and many discoveries made, his goal seemed yet distant even as death drew near.

The most significant milestone in Corlian's work was the raising of dead that would remain animated even without aid from the necromancer. Corlian saw little use in this, but took it as proof of his theories and an important step towards greater things. He describes this discovery in detail here, someone with an aptitude for such things may be able to replicate it.
entries.zh:
这是一位名叫黑井的科利安的死灵术士留下的回忆录与研究笔记。他的晚年致力于探索：生命能否脱离实体与凡躯而存在。有人将此称为超脱，认为这是异能术士教团终极却难以企及的目标。

科利安染上不治之症后，研究愈发狂热，并做出了许多残酷的行为与实验。尽管付出阴暗的努力、取得不少发现，直到死亡逼近，目标似乎仍遥不可及。

他研究中最重要的突破，是唤起即使失去死灵术士支持，也能持续活动的亡者。科利安认为这没什么实用价值，却把它视为理论的证明，以及通向更伟大成果的重要一步。他在这里详细描述了这一发现，有相应天赋的人或许能够重现。

entries.en:
Dearest Lisiria,

I hope this letter finds you well, if it finds you at all. The messengers have stopped, but I've been told that for the right price I might get a letter to you. How are things in Scorpe? Here they are burning all writings indiscriminately, they make no exceptions, and take other things too. I set aside some books, telling them they could do no harm, but they would not listen and threatened violence. They took your letters too. When I think of all the books they burn I am filled with rage, but when I thought of them burning your letters I shed tears.

When this is finally all over I will look for you. It will be difficult and it may take time, but I will find you, do not lose hope my love.

Yours lovingly,

Noran
entries.zh:
亲爱的莉西莉娅：

如果这封信能送到你手中，愿你一切安好。信使已经停了，但有人告诉我，只要价钱合适，也许还能把信送到。斯科普那边怎么样？这里的人不分青红皂白地焚烧一切文字，毫无例外，还拿走别的东西。我留了几本书，告诉他们这些没有害处，可他们不听，还以暴力威胁。他们连你的信也拿走了。想到他们烧毁那些书，我满腔愤怒；可想到他们烧掉你的信，我却流下了眼泪。

等这一切终于结束，我会去找你。也许很难，也许需要时间，但我一定会找到你。亲爱的，不要失去希望。

深爱着你的，

诺兰

entries.en: There are others here, I sensed them. They are not of Hamon's group or my subjects and they did not come the same way as I did. I tracked them for some time and then they quickly vanished from my perception. This is just as it was for the one who escaped, and I know now that he moved through that portal. This must mean there is another somewhere, perhaps it is a more direct way to return to the surface.
entries.zh: 这里还有别人，我感应到了。他们不是哈蒙的人，也不是我的实验对象，来的路线也与我不同。我追踪了他们一会儿，随后他们便迅速从我的感知中消失。这和那个逃走的人一模一样，现在我知道，他穿过了那道传送门。这说明某处一定还有另一道门，也许能更直接地回到地表。

entries.zh: 戴上这顶头盔，即使在完全的黑暗中也能视物。[sq]

entries.en: Brothers and sisters, it is time to act. They have brought death and ruin upon us all, and now they scramble to hide the proof of their misdeeds and flee. We cannot simply forgive and forget. Those who don't know their past are doomed to repeat mistakes. When the enemy comes knocking at our door we will be unarmed and unprepared. Would you stand idle when assailed? Join us now, we are strong, we are many, and our cause is just.
entries.zh: 兄弟姐妹们，行动的时候到了。他们给所有人带来死亡与毁灭，如今却急着销毁罪证、逃之夭夭。我们不能就这么原谅、忘却。不知过去的人，注定重蹈覆辙。等敌人叩响我们的门，我们将手无寸铁、毫无准备。遭到袭击时，你难道还要袖手旁观？加入我们吧！我们力量强大，人数众多，我们的事业是正义的。

entries.en: It has come to my attention that you let Fengus borrow your key to the vault, and of course he "misplaced" it. The foreman is respected and we do sometimes let him borrow things, but we don't give him access to the vault! Everyone knows he's chums with that tavern keep who's up to no good. You need to remedy this immediately. If he can't produce the key within two days I expect you to take some men and thoroughly search his regular haunts and anyone who works under him. Find that key Donilan, or this will be your last blunder under my command.
entries.zh: 我听说，你把库房钥匙借给了芬格斯，而他果然把钥匙“弄丢”了。工头是受人尊敬，我们有时也会借东西给他，但绝不等于让他随意进库房！谁都知道，他和那个不干好事的酒馆老板称兄道弟。你必须马上补救。如果两天内他还拿不出钥匙，就带上几个人，彻底搜查他常去的地方，以及他手下的每个人。多尼兰，找到那把钥匙，否则这将是你在我手下犯的最后一个错误。

entries.en:
Keeper Oren,

As you know we expect supervisor Seren with a delegation from Manta three days from now. My dislike for those pompous fools has not changed. They revel in their appointment after their supposed success, everyone ignoring the difficulties of our grander scale and all the problems that can be ascribed to nothing but misfortune.

I want this place to look busy, impress them with our scale and the scope of our endeavour. Hire actors if you must, I don't care who they are so long as they look the part. Make it look grandiose, but orderly, not as if we're scrambling to prevent chaos. I need not tell you what's at stake and what this might mean for all of us, I do not question your ability, but I expect your best effort.
entries.zh:
看守奥伦：

你知道，三天后督查塞伦将率曼塔的代表团到访。我对那些自大蠢货的厌恶丝毫未减。他们自诩取得了成功，得以受任，便沾沾自喜。所有人都忽视了我们规模更大所面临的困难，也忽视了那些纯粹由厄运造成的问题。

我要这里显得繁忙，用我们的规模与事业的广度震撼他们。必要时就雇演员，我不在乎他们是谁，只要看起来像那么回事。要显得宏伟而井然有序，别像是在手忙脚乱地阻止混乱。此事关系重大，对我们所有人意味着什么，无需我再说。我不怀疑你的能力，但希望你全力以赴。

entries.en:
My love,

I leave this message as I will not be meeting you here again. I know that when we were last together you noticed the scaling on my neck. Neither of us should pretend it isn't so. I will go under Elento's care. He has told me that the changes are often harmless and that there is no risk of contagion, but in some case they develop gravely, and some also lose their minds. I will not risk you seeing me with disgust, or that I might cause you harm.

With all that's taking place I doubt we will see each other again. I've acted as if this were no more than tryst, for fear of upsetting what we had, but know that truly I love you.
entries.zh:
我的爱人：

我留下这封信，因为不会再来这里与你相见。上次相聚时，我知道你注意到了我脖子上的鳞片。我们都不该假装没有这回事。我会去接受埃伦托的照料。他说，这种变化通常无害，也不会传染，但有时会恶化得很严重，还有些人会失去理智。我不能冒险让你厌恶地看着我，也不能冒险伤害你。

眼下发生了这么多事，我想我们不会再见了。我一直装作这不过是一场私会，因为害怕破坏我们已有的一切，但请你知道，我是真的爱你。

entries.en:
I'm quite certain that young Thelia has a strong talent. She does not know it, but she perceives and discerns the thoughts of others in ways that ordinary people cannot. I'm sure you're aware of her particular empathy, and perhaps you too have suspected there's more to it.

I do not presume to suggest how you should handle it, and I'm sure you'd want to keep it quiet as things are, but she is already eagerly active and well liked in our community and her talents could be of great use to us. Perhaps you could talk to her, and she could put her ability to discreet use. I hope you know I would never put her in harm's way. I think her danger may be greater if she continues to be unaware of what she does.
entries.zh:
我相当确信，年轻的塞莉娅拥有很强的天赋。她自己并不知道，但她能以常人无法做到的方式感知、辨别他人的思想。你一定注意到了她格外敏锐的共情能力，也许你同样怀疑，这不只是普通的体贴。

我无意指点你该如何处理，也相信在眼下的局势中，你会希望保密。不过她已经热心参与我们的事务，很受大家喜爱，她的天赋也许能大有用处。或许你可以和她谈谈，让她谨慎运用自己的能力。希望你明白，我绝不会让她涉险。我反而觉得，若她一直不清楚自己在做什么，危险可能更大。

entries.en:
Alright, so I admit the new lad may indeed be a spy as you've said. He asks too many pertinent questions, and his cheery, helpful demeanour does not fit the times. Still I don't think that your boys should "ask him some questions" as they eloquently put it. We should keep a close eye on him and discover to whom he might report, maybe give him something false and see what comes of it. We're more likely to make our advantage this way, and there's still a chance that all we sense is our own irritation at his manner.

There may be another way for us to know the truth of it, but I cannot speak of it yet.
entries.zh:
好吧，我承认，新来的小伙子可能真像你说的那样，是个密探。他问的关键问题太多，那副乐呵呵、热心助人的样子，也与当下的世道不合。但我仍不赞成让你的人去“问他几个问题”——他们倒是说得漂亮。我们应该盯紧他，查清他可能向谁汇报，或许放些假消息，看看会发生什么。这样更可能占到便宜，而且也仍有可能，我们只是看不惯他的做派罢了。

也许还有别的办法能查明真相，不过现在我还不能说。

entries.en:
The inscription uses words and phrasing unfamiliar to you, but you are able to discern some of its meaning.

It appears to profess that the body is the seed of the mind and when laid to rest in peace the mind may bloom and take its true form.
entries.zh:
铭文所用的词语与措辞十分陌生，但你仍能辨明部分含义。

它似乎宣称，肉体是心智的种子。当肉体得以安然长眠，心智便可绽放，显露真正的形态。
